name: Two Squares Glued along a Common Edge
properties: For either order of $D$, each square realizes all four active subsets of the two common vertices. The local orders $(010,110,000,100)$ and $(000,100,001,101)$ have disjoint active sets and combine into a global peeling. If both local orders begin $(000,100)$, they conflict: the common vertex $000$ has two private neighbours but the mixed vertex $011$ needed for its incident cube is absent.
